name: Cook night from a reel
summary: A recipe reel becomes a cook night: friends claim the ingredients, vote a night and lock it.
useWhen: someone shares a recipe reel and says 'we're making this'
a potluck-style cook night where each person brings ingredients
dontUseWhen: splitting a grocery bill after the fact

params.costCents: rough total cost in cents, 0 if unknown
params.items: 3 to 9 ingredients: label and who already claimed it ('' if open)
